definition: PEFT adds parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA and prompt tuning to Transformers models.
details: Developed by Hugging Face (Sourab Mangrulkar, Sayak Paul and team) since 2022.

explainer.lead: How to install Hugging Face PEFT, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.

quickstart.python:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B")
config = LoraConfig(r=8, lora_alpha=16, target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"], task_type="CAUSAL_LM")
model = get_peft_model(model, config)
model.print_trainable_parameters()   # well under 1% of weights train

explainer.inAi: Fine-tune an LLM on a single GPU by training small adapter matrices; combine with 4-bit loading for QLoRA.
explainer.jsNote: Hugging Face PEFT is a Python library with no official JavaScript or TypeScript package; call it from a Python service if your app is written in JavaScript.

tiers.eli5: Instead of retraining the whole brain, you add a small adjustable clip-on that teaches it a new skill.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use PEFT to fine-tune large Transformers on modest hardware by attaching LoRA adapters or prompts rather than updating all weights. A pitfall is forgetting to manage adapter weights separately from the base model at save and load time.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as a library supplying parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, including LoRA and prompt tuning, for Transformers models; the given facts state no formulas or performance limits.

explainer.example: A team fine-tunes a large text model for a support-desk tone by training a LoRA adapter with PEFT while leaving the base model frozen.
